g.text: Figure 1 | Preserving meaning from expert responses to grouped claims.

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #625b6c

g.text: a, Coverage and faithfulness before grouping (purple) and after grouping (orange), shown for the same 320 simulated consultations. Coverage measures how much

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #625b6c

g.text: original claim content is retained; faithfulness measures whether the resulting claims preserve the source meaning. Both maps use identical axes and density

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #625b6c

g.text: normalisation. Contours enclose 50% and 90% of each estimated density; marginal curves show each metric separately. The grouping changes are constructed

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #625b6c

g.text: illustrations, not measured effects. b, Saved assistant-pilot retention across four synthetic scenarios (six panels and 55 reference-claim occurrences per

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #625b6c

g.text: scenario). Purple marks full preservation, amber adds partial preservation, and the pale remainder represents omissions. Judgments were unblinded self-

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #625b6c

g.text: review; all omissions reflect the eight-claim cap. c, Illustrative retention distributions for four information types, using a separate 120 simulated cases

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #625b6c

g.text: per type. Faint points show individual cases; prominent dots and horizontal segments show medians and interquartile ranges, not confidence intervals. These

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Arial', sans-serif; fill: #625b6c

g.text: panels do not establish a measured grouping effect or independently validated platform performance.
